CustomField.description: EASE sends Term in YEARS (30, 15, 20) but Transaction__c.Term_1st__c is stored in MONTHS (360, 180, 240) and is used as the month exponent in the Monthly_Payment_and_Interest__c P&I formula. This formula converts years to months so the UWM Insights mapping can write Term_1st__c directly. When EASE sends no usable term it falls back to the Transaction's current value, so the mapped write is a no-op instead of clearing the field.
CustomField.label: Loan Term (Months)
